ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: advantage_weighted_logsigmoid_pairwise_mean_margin_v1
ir.intuition: This loss retains the pairwise advantage-weighted logsigmoid structure but replaces the total-weight normalized sum aggregation with a mean aggregation over weighted losses. This simpler aggregation equally weights all pairs after weighting by advantage and removes explicit normalization by total weight, leading to potentially more stable gradients in some training scenarios while preserving pairwise semantics with advantage_gap normalization and smooth margin scaling.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
norm_adv = max(norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm_adv
scaled_diff = scale * tanh(diff)
loss = -logsigmoid(scaled_diff)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
return mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_adv = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm_value = ops.maximum(norm_adv, epsilon)
    diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_value)
    smooth_diff = ops.tanh(diff)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(scale, smooth_diff)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
